context: The binary tree has seven nodes. Root 1 has left child 7 and right child 3. The left-hand 7 has children 4 and 5. Node 3 has left child 6 and right child 7. Nodes 4, 5, 6, and the rightmost 7 are leaves.
Find paths from the root to all nodes with value 7, subject to the constraint that no path may contain a 3. Every path that continues through node 3 would violate the constraint.
description: The left subtree contains no 3. On visiting the left-hand 7 in preorder, record the valid path [1, 7] and continue checking its children 4 and 5.

The constraint applies as soon as the search reaches the root’s right child, 3. Return before adding 3 to path, skipping recursive calls to its children 6 and 7. The red node 3, scissors, and faded subtree indicate a skipped branch. The nodes themselves remain in the data structure.

frames.explanation: The only valid path is [1, 7]. Although the rightmost leaf has the target value 7, its path [1, 3, 7] passes through the forbidden node 3 and is pruned.
frames.title: Return early at node 3 to prune an invalid branch

summary: When searching for paths from the root to a 7 that avoid 3, return early at node 3 to prune its subtree, skipping 6 and the rightmost 7.
title: Pruning paths that contain 3
